messages:
marta: Hey — first day stuff. Okta sign-in finished but when I try Google Workspace it says "The account you're trying to access hasn't been created yet." Anyone I should ping?
alex_it: @marta I can see you in the directory but not in the SSO mapping for Google. Sending a group add now. Can you confirm employee ID?
marta: M1234
alex_it: Added you to rw-employees -> try again in a minute. Sometimes identity propagation takes a sec.
marta: still getting: "Account not provisioned". Using Chrome.
ProvisionerBot: ProvisionerBot created Google account for marta@redwood.ai — queued delivery.
alex_it: Two quick checks: 1) Are you signing into the exact corporate address? 2) Try incognito in case cookies are weird.
marta: ohhh I accidentally used marta.personal+work@gmail.com earlier. Trying marta@redwood.ai now...
marta: That worked! Thanks :tada:
marta: Next issue — 1Password shows "no seat available" when I click the invite link.
samir: Hey @alex_it I see seat pool at 0/200? That doesn't look right. @linda any billing/seat churn?
linda: No billing changes on our side. @alex_it can you re-run the seat assignment worker?
alex_it: Re-queued the seat assignment job. Deploy log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z INFO assign_seat marta success
2026-03-20T14:02:13Z WARN invitation_email_delayed
```
alex_it: Try the invite link again.
marta: Accepting... now accepted :white_check_mark:
marta: Last thing — trying to set up a YubiKey for Okta device trust and it fails with "device not recognized". I have a YubiKey 5Ci (USB-C + Lightning).
samir: What OS are you on? macOS Ventura?
marta: macOS 13.6.1
samir: Two things: plug into the USB-C directly (no hub), and check System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Security Keys to ensure USB devices allowed. Also confirm browser has security key permissions.
marta: Did that, still shows not recognized.
alex_it: Can you try `ykman info`? If you don't have yubikey-manager yet we can temporarily whitelist your device from the console so you can enroll.
marta: I don't have brew set up yet so no `ykman`.
linda: I can create a temporary passkey for device trust so you can finish enrollment, then you can enroll the YubiKey later. Temp passkey would be valid 48h. OK for you @marta?
marta: Yes please, that would be great :pray:
linda: Done — I just sent a temp passkey to marta@redwood.ai with 48h expiry, scope=DeviceTrustEnroll.
marta: Using the temp passkey now... enrolled! YubiKey enrollment step in Okta now shows success. Thanks so much.
josh: Welcome aboard @marta! If you need GitHub org access I can add you to infra and apps teams — ping me with your GH username.
marta: Thank you everyone, amazing start :heart:
